patterns: Hi
Hello
Hey
Good morning
Good evening
responses: Hello! I am the Scholarship Assistance Chatbot. How can I help you?

patterns: Who is eligible for scholarship?
What is the eligibility for scholarship?
Am I eligible for a scholarship?
What are the scholarship eligibility requirements?
Who can apply for scholarship?
responses: Scholarship eligibility depends on the scholarship scheme. It may include academic performance, family income, category, course and other requirements.

patterns: What documents are required for scholarship?
Which documents do I need?
What documents should I submit?
Documents needed for scholarship
What papers are required for scholarship?
responses: Commonly required documents may include student ID, marks card, income certificate, bank details and other documents specified by the scholarship authority.

patterns: How can I apply for scholarship?
How do I apply?
What is the scholarship application process?
How to submit scholarship application?
How can I register for scholarship?
responses: To apply, check the scholarship requirements, register on the appropriate portal or submit the required form, upload the necessary documents and complete the application.

patterns: What is the scholarship deadline?
When is the last date to apply?
When should I apply for scholarship?
What is the last date for scholarship application?
When does the scholarship application close?
responses: The application deadline depends on the scholarship scheme. Students should check the official scholarship notification for the current last date.

patterns: How much scholarship will I get?
What is the scholarship amount?
How much money is given in scholarship?
How much financial support does the scholarship provide?
What amount will I receive?
responses: The scholarship amount varies depending on the scheme, course, eligibility and other conditions.

patterns: How can I check my scholarship status?
What is my application status?
How do I track my scholarship application?
Can I check my scholarship application status?
Where can I see my scholarship status?
responses: You can usually check the application status by logging into the official scholarship portal using your registered details.

patterns: How can I renew my scholarship?
What is scholarship renewal?
How do I renew my scholarship?
Can I renew my scholarship next year?
What are the renewal requirements?
responses: Scholarship renewal requirements depend on the scheme. Students may need to maintain academic performance and submit the required renewal documents before the deadline.

patterns: Whom should I contact for help?
Who can help me with scholarship?
Where can I get scholarship assistance?
Who should I contact?
How can I get help?
responses: For assistance, contact your college scholarship coordinator or the official scholarship authority.

patterns: Bye
Goodbye
See you
Thank you
Thanks
responses: You're welcome! All the best with your scholarship application.
